name: ANSI/IEEE adjustable-core inductor symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for adjustable-core inductor, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The adjustable inductor form combines a winding with an adjustment function. Its drawing must identify the adjusted parameter and the product's permitted range, rather than interpreting an arrow as a signal connection.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Separate the adjustment indication from the winding leads.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: An adjustment arrow does not represent an extra conducting terminal unless the actual device diagram says so.
